decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service option close to the core offer, and with little evidence beyond a website mention its value is still uncertain, so keeping it is cheap, though it may be folded into the broader express line D.

The seventy-two-hour program is costlier to keep because of fast logistics, and it overlaps with the other express programs, but its uncertainty has not yet resolved and keeping it retains the upside.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door was featured on the home page and extends the established modular fire-door system, so its value is likely being realized at low incremental cost.
The multi-model express line has its own page and is the firm's main express platform, a strong option with growing value that is cheap to keep.
The online ordering and digital services platform fits the firm's direction toward service and advisory, and its value is still unfolding, so keeping the option justifies its modest running cost.
The fire and smoke protection door sits close to the core certified-safety portfolio, costs little to carry, and serves steady compliance demand.
